retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a rugged male figure in a cowboy hat, unified by a vibrant orange-to-magenta neon gradient overlay and hand-brushed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, centered portrait of a man wearing a cowboy hat and leather jacket, set against a dark, textured wooden background. The image is defined by a dramatic tri-tone color wash (yellow-orange-magenta) that creates a 'neon-noir' western atmosphere, paired with expressive, hand-drawn block lettering positioned on the subject's shoulder.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm orange light on the face contrasts with the deep magenta shadows on the clothing.
The diagonal orientation of the typography follows the slope of the subject's shoulder.
The rough texture of the wooden background mirrors the stubble and leather textures of the subject.
coreInvariants: Subject wearing a traditional cowboy hat

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose, highlighted in bright orange.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down to the bright white shirt, then follows the diagonal text on the left shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the background and hat brim provide high-contrast negative space.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the midtones with crushed blacks and high-value highlights on the shirt.

letterConstructionRules: Hand-painted appearance with visible brush strokes
Irregular baselines and varying character widths
Angled terminals and rough, distressed edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters lack crossbars or have very low, slanted ones
The 'R' has a short, aggressive leg

composition.overlap: Placed directly over the jacket texture
composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated as if painted on the garment

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive hand-drawn style with varying scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tactile, hand-painted feel of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and leather jacket against dark wood. Apply a vibrant orange-to-magenta gradient map. Ensure high contrast and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-painted, condensed block lettering in a diagonal upward slant on the left shoulder area using a pink-to-yellow gradient fill.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with crushed blacks?
Does the color palette strictly follow the orange/magenta/yellow scheme?
Is the text slanted and textured like a dry brush?
Is the cowboy hat a prominent silhouette element?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos on the hat or jacket
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the magenta tones are concentrated in the shadows.
Ensure the text looks integrated into the jacket's lighting.
Verify the cowboy hat brim creates a strong shadow across the eyes.
Confirm the background remains dark and textured.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rugged Portrait + Neon Gradient Map + Hand-Brushed Diagonal Typography
